and what good has that done anyone?

@@U01393@@
It makes me shudder.

@@U01395@@
In that case, sir, consider before it’s too late.

@@U01396@@
(They walk on.)

@@U01398@@
Yes, out of sight is out of mind.
But courtesy comes easily to you.
You have many friends much more clever than I—

@@U01400@@
No, my dear, what the world calls clever
is often nothing more than
vanity and narrow-mindedness.

@@U01402@@
I don’t understand.

@@U01404@@
How is it that simplicity, that innocence,
never recognize their sacred worth?
That meekness and humility,
loving, bountiful Nature's greatest gifts should—

@@U01406@@
If only you'll think of me for one brief moment,
I will have time enough to think of you.

@@U01408@@
I take it you're often alone.

@@U01410@@

translation:
@@U01391@@
单身汉——
这对任何人有什么好处呢？

@@U01393@@
这让我不寒而栗。

@@U01395@@
既然如此，先生，请考虑一下，以免为时已晚。

@@U01396@@
（他们继续走。）

@@U01398@@
是的，眼不见心不烦。
但礼貌对你来说很容易。
你有很多比我聪明得多的朋友——

@@U01400@@
不，亲爱的，世人所说的聪明
往往无非是
虚荣和心胸狭隘。

@@U01402@@
我不明白。

@@U01404@@
怎么会那么简单、那么天真，
从来没有认识到他们的神圣价值？
那种温柔和谦卑，
充满爱心、慷慨的大自然最伟大的礼物应该——

@@U01406@@
如果你能短暂地想起我就好了
我会有足够的时间想你。

@@U01408@@
我想你经常是一个人。

@@U01410@@
是的。而且尽管我们家的
